use: Unmodified standalone meshes/digit.STL, split into housing and curved gel connected components at load time; module appended to stock fingertips. TACTO lighting/rendering/force adjustment reused; actual CAD front surface replaces the default flat optical gel, without scaling. CGL initialization and MuJoCo contact/pose integration are local. Default 240x320 resolution and empty-contact background match the source example; original calibration and random RGB noise execute without local gains. DIGIT bench and Panda contact solver reuse tacto_common.xml Newton/100 defaults, impratio=20, noslip_iterations=5, elliptic cone and multiccd; local friction coefficients remain documented separately.
